relationships.subject: PGE2
relationships.evidence_quote: We found that PGE2 but not vehicle, evoked a large TRPM2-dependent inward current in cells coexpressing EP4 receptor

relationships.subject: GαoA
relationships.evidence_quote: GαoA but not vector cotransfection is sufficient to trigger TRPM2-dependent inward currents

relationships.subject: IgG immune complex
relationships.evidence_quote: IgG-IC perfusion also activated TRPM2 currents in HEK293 cells expressing FcγRI and TRPM2 but not in cells expressing TRPM2 or FcγRI alone

relationships.subject: FcγRI
relationships.evidence_quote: TRPM2 bound to FcγRI (Fig. 6K), suggesting that TRPM2 and FcγRI form a receptor-channel complex

relationships.subject: JNJ-28583113
relationships.evidence_quote: pharmacological blockade of TRPM2 with JNJ-28583113 also entirely reversed acute joint pain induced by IgG-IC

relationships.subject: Neuronal TRPM2
relationships.evidence_quote: TRPM2 is not involved in PGE2 production

key_findings: Neuronal TRPM2 directly transduces chronic arthritis and early-stage neuropathic pain independently of immune TRPM2 and inflammation.
PGE2 (via Gαi/o-coupled EP3/EP4 and GαoA) and IgG-IC (via FcγRI) activate TRPM2; CGRP in joints was unchanged by AIA.
